meta.author: self
meta.note: 全部自撰，不复制任何真题原文

items.zh: 教育被认为是改变个人命运最有效的途径之一。
items.reference: Education is considered to be one of the most effective ways to change a person's fate.

keyPoints.head: one of the most effective ways
synonyms: one of the most effective means

hints: 得分点：被认为是 / 最有效的途径之一 / 改变 / 个人命运
「被认为」用 be considered / regarded / thought to be；「……之一」后接复数名词 ways
句型：Education is considered to be one of the most effective ways to do sth.

items.zh: 随着互联网的发展，在线课程正受到越来越多学生的欢迎。
items.reference: With the development of the Internet, online courses are becoming increasingly popular among students.
hints: 得分点：随着……的发展 / 在线课程 / 越来越受欢迎 / 在学生中
「随着……」可用 with the development of + 名词；among 用于三者以上的群体
句型：With the development of …, online courses are becoming increasingly popular among students.

items.zh: 老师鼓励学生独立思考，而不是盲目接受现成的答案。
items.reference: Teachers encourage students to think independently rather than blindly accept ready-made answers.
hints: 得分点：鼓励学生 / 独立思考 / 而不是 / 现成的答案
「鼓励某人做」用 encourage sb. to do；rather than 后接动词原形，instead of 后接动名词
句型：Teachers encourage students to … rather than blindly accept …

items.zh: 尽管备考压力很大，他仍然坚持每天背诵三十个新单词。
items.reference: Although he is under great pressure preparing for the exam, he still insists on reciting thirty new words every day.

keyPoints.head: although he is under great pressure
synonyms: though he is under great pressure

hints: 得分点：尽管压力很大 / 备考 / 坚持 / 背诵
「处于压力下」用 be under pressure；insist on / persist in 后接动名词
句型：Although he is under great pressure …, he still insists on reciting … every day.

items.zh: 家长应当关注孩子的全面发展，而不只是考试成绩。
items.reference: Parents should pay attention to their children's all-round development rather than merely their exam scores.
hints: 得分点：关注 / 全面发展 / 而不是 / 考试成绩
「全面发展」可用 all-round / overall / well-rounded development；pay attention to 中 to 是介词
句型：Parents should pay attention to … rather than merely …

items.zh: 这所大学以其严格的学术要求和优秀的师资闻名于国内外。
items.reference: This university is famous for its strict academic requirements and excellent faculty both at home and abroad.
hints: 得分点：以……而闻名 / 闻名于国内外 / 严格的学术要求 / 优秀的师资
「国内外」固定为 at home and abroad；「师资」可用 faculty 或 teaching staff（集合名词）
句型：This university is famous both at home and abroad for its … and …

items.zh: 良好的学习习惯和明确的目标是提高学习效率的关键。
items.reference: Good study habits and clear goals are the key to improving learning efficiency.
hints: 得分点：良好的学习习惯 / 明确的目标 / ……的关键 / 提高学习效率
「……的关键」用 the key to，其中 to 是介词，后接动名词
句型：Good study habits and clear goals are the key to improving …

items.zh: 越来越多的高中生选择出国留学，以开阔国际视野。
items.reference: An increasing number of high school students choose to study abroad in order to broaden their international horizons.
hints: 得分点：越来越多的 / 高中生 / 出国留学 / 以 / 开阔国际视野
「出国留学」用 study abroad，abroad 是副词，不加 to；「开阔眼界」用 broaden one's horizons
句型：An increasing number of … choose to study abroad in order to broaden …

items.zh: 阅读不仅能扩大词汇量，还能提高写作水平。
items.reference: Reading can not only enlarge one's vocabulary but also improve one's writing.
hints: 得分点：扩大词汇量 / 不仅 / 还 / 提高写作水平
「扩大词汇量」用 enlarge / expand / build up one's vocabulary；vocabulary 表示「词汇量」时可用单数
句型：Reading can not only … but also …

items.zh: 为了减轻学生的负担，学校减少了家庭作业的数量。
items.reference: In order to reduce students' burden, the school has reduced the amount of homework.
hints: 得分点：为了 / 减轻学生的负担 / 减少了……的数量 / 家庭作业
「减轻负担」用 reduce / lighten the burden；homework 不可数，用 the amount of 修饰
句型：In order to reduce students' burden, the school has reduced the amount of homework.

items.zh: 参加社团活动有助于培养学生的团队合作精神。
items.reference: Taking part in club activities helps to cultivate students' team spirit.
hints: 得分点：参加 / 社团活动 / 有助于培养 / 团队合作精神
「参加（活动）」用 take part in / participate in；「培养」用 cultivate / develop
句型：Taking part in … helps to cultivate students' team spirit.

items.zh: 有人认为考试是检验学习成果最公平的方式，也有人持相反意见。
items.reference: Some people believe that exams are the fairest way to test learning outcomes, while others hold the opposite view.
hints: 得分点：有人认为 / 最公平的方式 / 检验学习成果 / 而其他人 / 持相反意见
表示对比可用 while / whereas；「持……观点」用 hold a view / an opinion
句型：Some people believe that … , while others hold the opposite view.

items.zh: 教师不仅传授知识，还在学生的成长过程中起着不可替代的作用。
items.reference: Teachers not only impart knowledge but also play an irreplaceable role in the growth of students.
hints: 得分点：传授知识 / 不仅 / 起着不可替代的作用 / 学生的成长
「传授」用 impart / pass on；「起……作用」用 play a(n) … role in，in 后接名词或动名词
句型：Teachers not only impart knowledge but also play an irreplaceable role in …

items.zh: 近年来，职业教育和技能培训受到了前所未有的重视。
items.reference: In recent years, vocational education and skills training have received unprecedented attention.

keyPoints.head: have received unprecedented attention
keyPoints.zh: 受到了前所未有的重视

hints: 得分点：近年来 / 职业教育 / 技能培训 / 受到了前所未有的重视
「前所未有的」用 unprecedented；「受到重视」可用 receive attention 或 be attached importance to
句型：In recent years, … have received unprecedented attention.

items.zh: 只有把所学知识运用到实践中，我们才能真正掌握它。
items.reference: Only by applying what we have learned to practice can we truly master it.
hints: 得分点：只有通过 / 把所学知识运用 / 到实践中 / 真正掌握
only + 状语置于句首时主句要部分倒装；apply … to … 中 to 是介词
句型：Only by applying what we have learned to practice can we truly master it.

items.zh: 许多大学生利用课余时间做兼职，以积累社会经验。
items.reference: Many college students take part-time jobs in their spare time so as to accumulate social experience.
hints: 得分点：大学生 / 做兼职 / 利用课余时间 / 以 / 积累社会经验
「兼职工作」为 part-time job；「积累（经验）」用 accumulate / gain
句型：Many college students take part-time jobs in their spare time so as to accumulate …

items.zh: 图书馆为学生提供了丰富的参考书和安静的学习环境。
items.reference: The library provides students with a wealth of reference books and a quiet study environment.
hints: 得分点：为学生提供 / 丰富的 / 参考书 / 安静的学习环境
「为某人提供某物」用 provide sb. with sth.；「丰富的」可用 a wealth of / an abundance of
句型：The library provides students with a wealth of … and a quiet study environment.

items.zh: 与死记硬背相比，理解性记忆能让学生记得更牢。
items.reference: Compared with learning by rote, understanding-based memorization allows students to remember things better.
hints: 得分点：与……相比 / 死记硬背 / 让学生能够 / 记得更牢
「死记硬背」可用 learn by rote / rote learning；compared with 为固定过去分词短语
句型：Compared with …, … allows students to remember things better.

items.zh: 政府已投入大量资金用于改善偏远地区的办学条件。
items.reference: The government has invested a large amount of money in improving school conditions in remote areas.
hints: 得分点：已投入 / 大量资金 / 改善办学条件 / 在偏远地区
「投入（资金）」用 invest … in；in 是介词，后接动名词 improving
句型：The government has invested a large amount of money in improving … in remote areas.

items.zh: 无论学习什么科目，持之以恒都是取得成功的关键。
items.reference: No matter what subject you study, perseverance is the key to success.
hints: 得分点：无论什么 / 持之以恒 / ……的关键 / 成功
「无论什么」可用 no matter what 或 whatever；success 表「成功」这一抽象概念时不可数
句型：No matter what subject you study, perseverance is the key to success.
